rule: Open when ratio >= on. Stay open while ratio >= off (off = baseline + release_factor * threshold; baseline = 0 for the absolute variant). Frames without a face are skipped; if more than max_gap_s passes since the last frame that kept it open, close at that frame. A yawn is an open stretch whose last frame is at least min_duration_s after its first.

feature.name: inner_lip_gap_over_outer_eye_corner_distance_2d_px
feature.formula: dist(upper_inner_lip, lower_inner_lip) / dist(right_eye_outer, left_eye_outer), 2D Euclidean distance in pixels (x * image_width, y * image_height)

trainedOn: YawDD Mirror, 307 videos of 90 subjects (Normal, Talking, Yawning)
citation: S. Abtahi, M. Omidyeganeh, S. Shirmohammadi, and B. Hariri, "YawDD: A Yawning Detection Dataset", Proc. ACM Multimedia Systems, Singapore, March 19-21 2014.
